rational_certificate_logic: The family-to-state aggregation matrix and Krylov future matrix are integer matrices.
Rank 1179 modulo an odd prime implies a nonzero integer 1179x1179 minor.
The exact rational future dimension is independently certified as 1179.
Therefore the rational measurement rank is exactly 1179.
The same logic with the shifted persistent Krylov block gives exact rational rank 1167.
minimality_scope: Within the recency-frame + capped-age_b augmentation family: no extra age bit is insufficient (rank 1144), one binary adjacency bit is sufficient (rank 1179). This is not a universal information-theoretic minimality claim.
